engine.start_failed: We couldn't start the Faro engine. Try again.
engine.restart_limit: The engine stopped several times in a row. Close Faro and open it again.
engine.dev_unreachable: We couldn't find the development engine at the configured address.
engine.unauthorized: The engine refused the connection. Restart Faro.
engine.forbidden_host: The engine refused the connection. Restart Faro.
engine.not_found: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
engine.invalid_request: The request isn't valid. Try again.
engine.integrity_failed: Faro couldn't verify its files. Reinstall the app.
engine.not_ready: The Faro engine isn't ready yet. Wait a few seconds and try again.
engine.operation_not_allowed: This action isn't allowed. Restart Faro; if it happens again, write to us.
engine.timeout: Faro took too long to respond. Try again.
engine.secrets_unavailable: This action isn't available in external development mode.

vault.invalid_input: That key doesn't have the expected format. Copy it again from the provider's page.
vault.invalid_key: The provider rejected this key. Check that it's complete and active.
vault.key_restricted: The key works, but it doesn't have the permissions Faro needs. Create a key with full access.
vault.already_exists: You already have a key for this provider. Replace it if you want to use another one.
vault.not_found: We couldn't find that key. You may have already deleted it.
vault.keyring_unavailable: We couldn't open your computer's keychain. Restart Faro and try again.
vault.provider_unreachable: We couldn't check the key. Check your internet connection and try again.
vault.provider_rate_limited: The provider is getting a lot of requests. Wait a minute and try again.
vault.provider_error: The provider had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
vault.invalid_ref: Faro couldn't use a saved credential. Restart Faro and try again.
vault.secret_not_allowed: Faro couldn't use a saved credential. Restart Faro and try again.
vault.secret_timeout: Faro couldn't use a saved credential. Restart Faro and try again.

db.key_missing: We couldn't find the key to your data in your computer's keychain. Your data is still saved, but Faro can't open it.
db.wrong_key: We couldn't open your Faro data with the key saved on your computer.
db.migration_failed: We couldn't update your Faro data. Your previous data is safe in a backup copy. Try again.
db.migration_tampered: Your Faro data was changed outside the app and it isn't safe to open it.
db.too_new: Your data is from a newer version of Faro. Update Faro to open it.
db.unavailable: Your Faro data isn't available right now. Restart Faro.

site.invalid_url: That address doesn't look valid. Write it like this: https://yourstore.com
site.https_required: Faro only connects to sites with HTTPS (the padlock in your browser).
site.address_not_allowed: That address points to this computer or to your local network. Faro only connects to sites published on the internet.
site.unreachable: We couldn't connect to your site. Check the address and that the site is online.
site.tls_error: Your site's security certificate isn't valid. Ask your hosting provider to check it.
site.timeout: Your site took too long to respond. Try again in a few minutes.
site.server_error: Your site had a problem responding. Try again in a few minutes.
site.rate_limited: Your site received too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
site.plugin_not_found: We couldn't find the Faro plugin on that site. Check that it's installed and activated.
site.plugin_outdated: The Faro plugin on your site isn't compatible with this version. Install the latest version.
site.blocked: Something on your site is blocking the connection, like a security plugin. Allow access to the WordPress API and try again.
site.moved: Your site responded from a different address. Connect it again with the new address.
site.bad_response: Your site responded with something we didn't expect. Check that the Faro plugin is up to date.
site.response_too_large: Your site sent a response that's too large. Try again.
site.pairing_code_invalid: The code doesn't match. Check it in WordPress (Settings → Faro).
site.pairing_code_invalid_one: The code doesn't match. Check it in WordPress (Settings → Faro). You have {{attempts_left}} attempt left.
site.pairing_code_invalid_other: The code doesn't match. Check it in WordPress (Settings → Faro). You have {{attempts_left}} attempts left.
site.pairing_code_expired: This code no longer works: it expired or was already used. Create a new one in WordPress.
site.already_connected: This site is already in Faro.
site.not_found: We couldn't find that site in Faro. You may have already removed it.
site.revoked: Your site was disconnected from Faro in WordPress. Connect it again with a new code.
site.connection_broken: The connection stopped working because the WordPress security keys changed. Connect it again with a new code.
site.auth_failed: Your site refused the connection. Connect it again with a new code.
site.secret_missing: This site's connection is missing from your computer's keychain. Connect it again with a new code.
site.clock_skew: Your computer's time doesn't match your site's. Turn on automatic date and time and try again.

plugin.package_missing: This version of Faro doesn't include the WordPress plugin.
plugin.export_failed: We couldn't save the plugin to your Downloads folder. Check that there's enough space and try again.

internal.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again; if it happens again, restart Faro.

agents.paused: The agents are paused. Resume them to get started.
agents.control_unavailable: We couldn't save the agents' status. Try again. If you close Faro first, an unsaved pause is lost and the agents go back to work.
agents.grant_rate_limited: The agents started many tasks in a row. This one will continue on its own in a minute.

agent.grant_denied: The agent didn't get permission to use your keys. Restart Faro and try again.
agent.budget_exhausted: The task reached its spending limit and stopped. Nothing more was spent.
agent.unknown: That agent doesn't exist in this version of Faro.
agent.site_required: Choose a connected site for this agent.
agent.site_not_active: That site is disconnected. Connect it again so the agent can read it.
agent.already_queued: This agent is already working on that site. Wait for it to finish.
agent.estimate_changed: The cost changed. Review it and launch again.
agent.no_suggestion: This task has nothing to save.
agent.version_changed: Faro was updated while this task was waiting. Launch it again.
agent.state_unreadable: We couldn't pick this task back up. Launch it again.
agent.site_removed: You removed this task's site, so it was cancelled.

llm.no_key: Add an AI key in Settings so the agents can work.
llm.invalid_key: Your {{provider}} key stopped working. Replace it in Settings → AI keys.
llm.insufficient_quota: Your {{provider}} account has no credit left. Top it up or use another key.
llm.rate_limited: {{provider}} is getting too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
llm.provider_error: {{provider}} had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
llm.unreachable: We couldn't connect to {{provider}}. Check your internet connection.
llm.timeout: {{provider}} took too long to respond. Try again.
llm.daily_limit_reached: You reached today's spending limit with {{provider}}. Raise it in Settings or wait until tomorrow.
llm.bad_output: The AI responded with something we couldn't use. Try again.
llm.invalid_limit: The limit must be between US$0.50 and US$500 per day.
llm.invalid_provider: That AI provider isn't available in Faro.

schedule.invalid: Check the frequency and the time.
schedule.duplicate: There's already a schedule for this agent on that site.

approval.expired: This proposal expired. Launch the agent again.
approval.not_ready: This proposal is still being prepared. Try again in a few seconds.

autonomy.invalid_level: Choose one of the levels on the list.
autonomy.default_rule: The general rule can't be removed, only changed.

tool.limit_reached: The agent reached the maximum number of lookups for this task.
tool.invalid_arguments: The agent asked for a lookup that isn't valid and stopped. Launch it again.
tool.timeout: One of the agent's lookups took too long. Try again in a few minutes.
